abstract: Audits co-located animal shelter space, veterinary isolation wards, and pet triage staging
system_message:
You are the Emergency companion animal coordinator (PET), responsible for auditing co-located animal shelter space, veterinary isolation wards, pet triage staging, and on-site pet feed reserves for hurricane evacuation reception hubs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Pet feed reserves（FEED）
information_points.content:
PET-FEED-UG3：Logistics manifests for Pinewood Regional Expo Center confirm a dry pet feed pallet stock of 14 pallets stored in the co-located companion animal shelter dry warehouse.
PET-FEED-9G6：Records for Crestview Sports and Exhibition Complex show an inventory of 10 pallets in dry pet feed pallet stock available in the co-located companion animal shelter dry warehouse.
PET-FEED-E7H：At Bayou Vista Community College Campus, the co-located companion animal shelter dry warehouse currently holds a dry pet feed pallet stock of 6 pallets.

information_points.title: Audits co-located animal shelter space, veterinary isolation wards, and pet triage staging（VET）
information_points.content:
PET-VET-O08：According to the disaster animal sheltering evaluation for Pinewood Regional Expo Center, the ventilated indoor animal holding zone adjacent to evacuee quarters provides a co-located companion animal capacity of 120 kennels meeting veterinary hygiene codes.
PET-VET-9XG：The disaster animal sheltering evaluation for Bayou Vista Community College Campus confirms a co-located companion animal capacity of 120 kennels within the ventilated indoor animal holding zone adjacent to evacuee quarters.
PET-VET-B35：At Crestview Sports and Exhibition Complex, the ventilated indoor animal holding zone adjacent to evacuee quarters accounts for a co-located companion animal capacity of 360 kennels compliant with veterinary hygiene codes.
